sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 46038 of 2021
Applicant :- Pawan

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kundan Kumar,Soneya Advani,Srijan Mehrotra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.
This is second bail application filed by applicant- Pawan in Case Crime No. 148 of 2015, under Sections 304B, 498A, 506 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Dhaulana, District Hapur.
First bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 02.04.2019.
2. This bail application is pending before Court for last about two and half years.

Sri Kundan Kumar,
Ms. Soneya Advani and Sri Srijan Mehrotra, learned counsel for applicant is not present and present status of trial is also not on record.
3. This Court finds that in some of cases Advocates are not appearing possibly on ground that they have no instructions or nothing survives in the matter.

However, being an Advocate and Officer of Court, they are under legal obligation to appear before Court and assist, whether they have received Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86629712/
1 proper instructions or not as the Vakalatnama filed by them has put them under solemn duty to appear before Court.
4.

entities.text: Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri Rakesh Kumar Mishra, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant, who is in jail since 28.06.2015, is facing trial for offence of demand of dowry and dowry death.
However, present status of trial is not on record.

5. In aforesaid circumstances, taking note of evidence against applicant and that present status of trial is not on record and also that applicant is in jail since 28.06.2015, therefore, even in absence of counsel for applicant, in the interest of justice, this application is disposed of with observation that in case trial is not concluded till date, applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court concerned, as advised, afresh alongwith status of trial.
Meanwhile, Trial Court shall take all endeavour to conclude trial.
6. A copy of this order be communicated to applicant through Jail Superintendent concerned.

Order Date :- 14.5.2024 AK  Pawan vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86629712/
